_doc: species.<id>.bodies: one capsule PhysicalBone3D per entry; unlisted bones follow their parent.
bone: the bone the body drives. from/to: bones whose heads bound the capsule (default: the bone's head, its only child's head).
dir [x,y,z] + length (m): capsule direction in skeleton rest space for end bones (default: the bone's +Y).
radius (m, world) or radius_frac (of the capsule length). length_scale, extend (m), offset [x,y,z] (m, rest skeleton space).
mass_frac: share of mass_kg (unset shares split by capsule volume). angular_damp / linear_damp / friction override physics.
joint: to the nearest ancestor body. cone {swing, twist} deg, twist axis along the bone.
hinge {axis [x,y,z] in rest skeleton space, min, max} deg: right-hand rotation of the child about axis, from REST.
pin {} ball joint without limits. The root body (no ancestor body) has no joint.
species.<id>.reparent {bone: new_parent}: donor rigs hang IK feet off 'root'; move them under their limb first.
species.<id>.hit_react_s: seconds of the death clip before the ragdoll takes over (default timing.hit_react_s).
species.<id>.hips: bone used for the corpse position and the lie-down gate. feet: bones the lab checks are not left in the air.
Distances in metres at game scale (the creature is scaled to height_meters); points/axes in the GLB's skeleton space.
